attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as router between lan-a (vtnet1/opt1, 10.60.10.0/24, toward node2) and lan-b (vtnet2/opt2, 10.60.20.0/24, toward node3). Added a logged pf block rule for TCP/23 on both opt1 and opt2 (other traffic still passes), verified a telnet-style attempt from node2 to node3 is refused and logged on node1's filter log, then restarted all three nodes one at a time and re-verified the block+log behavior and network state persisted after each restart.
